title: Mobile Wallet Funding Collection and Rate Lock Terms
content:
## Terms

(a) **Collection.** For a **Mobile Wallet** transfer, card and pay-by-bank payments are collected at booking, an ACH debit when it settles, and a wire when it arrives.

(b) **Rate guarantee.** The quoted rate is guaranteed for the tier's rate lock hours, counted as elapsed hours from the moment the transfer was booked.

(c) **Re-quote.** A rate is re-quoted only when funds are collected more than the tier's rate lock hours after the transfer was booked. Lock hours are counted as elapsed hours from the booking moment to the moment the funds are collected; funds collected at exactly the end of the lock are not late, so no re-quote follows. The booking moment and the collection moment are taken from the transfer's system record.

(d) **What a re-quote changes.** A re-quote uses the rate sheet for the collection date with the same margin rule, re-discloses the exchange rate, the amount to be credited and the date available, and never changes fees.

(e) **Wire deadline.** On a tier whose inbound wire deadline is above 0, Paloma cancels a wire-funded booking whose funds have not arrived by the booking moment plus that many elapsed hours.

(f) **Failed funding.** When an ACH debit is returned unpaid before release or a card capture fails, Paloma cancels the transfer with the hold reason "funding failed".

(g) **Nothing owed back.** Nothing is owed back on a cancellation for missing or failed funding, and the transfer stays cancelled.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical times, Mobile Wallet Economy, lock of 96 hours)

| Booked | Funds collected | Elapsed hours | Re-quote |
|---|---|---|---|
| 09:00 on day 1 | 09:00 on day 5 | exactly 96 | no; not more than the lock |
| 09:00 on day 1 | 09:01 on day 5 | 96 and one minute | yes; rate, amount and date available re-disclosed, fees unchanged |
| 09:00 on day 1 | 15:00 on day 3 | 54 | no |

On Mobile Wallet Large Amount, whose wire deadline is 48 hours, a wire-funded booking made at 10:00 on day 1 whose funds have not arrived by 10:00 on day 3 is cancelled by Paloma, and nothing is owed back.
